public_rationale: The February research documents continuing hallucinations and reasoning failures, including failures in simple scenarios and reasoning about physical actions. That supports the ordinary behavioral reading: models remained unreliable about facts and real-world constraints. The finding does not establish that they possess no world representations. Earlier research supplies material evidence against that stronger reading, so the interpretation is explicit and affects the result.
limitations: Support for the reality clause is behavioral, not a determination about an internal mental concept.
The reasoning review synthesizes experiments conducted at different earlier dates.
Publication-month dates represent the reported state of evidence; individual experiment dates were not established.
The result does not imply an absence of progress or useful capabilities.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Large language models still hallucinate, make boneheaded errors, and lack a proper concept of reality.

statement.excerpt: Large language models still hallucinate, and they still make boneheaded errors; they still lack a proper concept of reality.
statement.document_title: Turns out Generative AI was a scam

from_speaker: lack a proper concept of reality
our_interpretation: Hallucinate means produce plausible factual claims that are false or unsupported.
Boneheaded errors means failures on seemingly simple reasoning tasks.

Read a proper concept of reality behaviorally: dependable, coherent reasoning about real-world facts, physical constraints and actions. Do not interpret it as asserting that models contain no representations of the world.
For this ongoing state, use the latest pre-publication reporting month, February 2026, through the post date.
The claim concerns recurring limitations across LLMs, not failure by every model on every task.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evaluations document hallucinations, simple reasoning failures and recurring failures to respect real-world constraints in capable LLMs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous, broad evaluations establish that these limitations had been reliably resolved across relevant tasks and model configurations.

evidence.excerpt: Content grounding remains a major challenge even with web search.
evidence.explanation: The reported evaluation finds persistent factual grounding failures across tested model configurations, including configurations with search. This supports the hallucination component.

evidence.excerpt: Despite these advances, significant reasoning failures persist, occurring even in seemingly simple scenarios.
evidence.locator: Abstract, second sentence; full paper section 5.2 provides embodied-reasoning discussion
evidence.publisher: Transactions on Machine Learning Research; arXiv author copy
evidence.explanation: The review supports continuing elementary reasoning failures. Its full text also describes physically infeasible plans, affordance mistakes and spatial failures, supporting the behavioral reading of the reality clause.

evidence.excerpt: We discover that LLMs learn linear representations of space and time across multiple scales.
evidence.publisher: arXiv; Wes Gurnee and Max Tegmark
evidence.explanation: This earlier study finds structured representations in Llama-2 models. It challenges a literal claim that LLMs have no representation of reality, but does not establish dependable real-world reasoning in the target period.
